scientific_hypothesis: A domain-valid accepted counterexample affects the real FME controller only if it weakens an already-recorded claim linked to the degraded candidate and that canonical claim transition changes the next generation action.

confirmed_defects.finding: EOH initialization sampled two times population size but the frozen budget counted only evolution samples.
confirmed_defects.correction: Make initial_sample_nums explicit and validate the manifest remote-call lower bound before output creation.

confirmed_defects.finding: Eight model-generated initialization candidates had no action or outcome receipt.
confirmed_defects.correction: Receipt every initialization generation attempt and join successful candidate evidence to its action receipt.

confirmed_defects.finding: Two domain-valid counterexamples were admitted but neither transitioned an existing claim.
confirmed_defects.correction: On admission, transition eligible claims linked to degraded strong candidates using the counterexample constraint evidence hash.

confirmed_defects.finding: The observed repair action was selected to stabilize generation failures, not because counterevidence weakened a claim.
confirmed_defects.correction: Replay the same evidence with and without the accepted counterexample and require the recorded-counterexample repair reason only in the intervention state.

allowed_changes: explicit initial_sample_nums configuration and CLI propagation
candidate-to-claim runtime index reconstructed from the canonical archive
counterexample-driven transition of an existing eligible claim
forbidden_changes: confirmation or heldout feedback into evolution
new API call before offline acceptance
rewrite of the D1 v1 contract manifest or reports

remote_call_accounting.generated_initialization_samples_per_coo: initial_sample_nums unless frozen seeds are used
remote_call_accounting.evolution_samples_per_coordinate: generations times pop_size unless max_sample_nums is explicit
remote_call_accounting.internal_provider_retries: must be separately bounded and reported

zero_api_acceptance: four initialization attempts produce four action receipts and four outcome receipts with no model call in the harness
successful initialization evidence receipts join to their action receipts
a second candidate admits a domain-valid counterexample that degrades the first candidate
the first candidate existing claim transitions from proposed to weakened
the next controller action is repair_failed_mechanism with reason repair_a_mechanism_broken_by_recorded_counterexample
removing the counterexample and transition changes the counterfactual action
the corrected manifest budget validator rejects D1 v1 and accepts a correctly accounted v2 fixture
next_gate: Only after all zero-API checks pass may a new versioned D1 API manifest be frozen with a corrected numeric budget.
